name: AE Member Enrollment Operational Dashboard
description: Working-team dashboard for Member Annual Enrollment: full Enrollment Status breakdown by Wave, election-detail counts/averages (HSA/FSA/Supplemental Life/Retirement/Vision), and a waiver trend by membership type (Sponsored vs. Retired). Split off from AE Member Enrollment (Snap) on 2026-09-22, same suite structure as the Employer Election family.

feeds.description: ONE consolidated model, all 9 dimensions in this exact order -- RowKind (StatusByWave/DailyTrend/ElectionSummary/WaiverTrend discriminator), EventDate, Wave, Enrollment_Status, Defaulted, Defaulted_Timing, ActivityDate, Membership_Type, Is_Portico_Employee. A single SAC widget can only bind to one Analytic Model total (confirmed on the Employer Election project) -- DS_MEMBER_ENROLLMENT_SUMMARY is now a UNION ALL of 4 row-kinds, each populating only the dimensions/measures relevant to it and leaving the rest NULL. main.js filters this one dataset by dimensions_0 (RowKind) per panel, and excludes Is_Portico_Employee = 'Yes' (added 2026-10-01) -- see sac-member-operational-portico-widget for the mirror widget that shows ONLY them.

ONE consolidated model, all 22 measures in this exact order -- MemberCount, MultipleAttemptsMemberCount, TotalEligibleLives, TotalCoveredLives, WaivedCount, HSA_Count, HSA_Avg_Amount, FSA_Health_Count, FSA_Health_Avg_Amount, FSA_Dependent_Count, FSA_Dependent_Avg_Amount, SuppLife_Member_Count, SuppLife_Member_Avg_Amount, SuppLife_Spouse_Count, SuppLife_Spouse_Avg_Amount, SuppLife_Dependent_Count, SuppLife_Dependent_Avg_Amount, Retirement_Pretax_Count, Retirement_Pretax_Avg_Amount, Retirement_Roth_Count, Retirement_Roth_Avg_Amount, Vision_Election_Count. Each row-kind (see dimensions_0) only populates its own relevant measures; the rest are NULL on that row.

refresh.description: Re-renders the dashboard from the currently bound data
